dialogue.dialogue: who are you?
I'm Eshan
why are you talking in uppercase?
we don't do that here.
Well, I do!
you're generally just going against the style of this game.
that's making me unnessecarilly angry.
Yeah that's kinda the name of the expression you're using
I guess I'll have to end the dialouge now so I can get away
oh, howdy, stranger!
nice day for workin', ain't it?
too bad the weedwhacker's broke...
i can't find them darn replacement blades anywhere!
hey, if ya see 'em around, bring 'em here, see?
i'll keep an eye out.
by the way, you wouldn't happen to have seen my sweater button around, would you?
this is my favourite sweater...
sweater button? hmm, can't say i've seen it.
tell ya what, you keep an eye out for them weedwhacker blades, an' i'll keep a lookout for your button!
thanks, dude.
found anythin' yet?
nope. you found any buttons?
i didn't, but i'll keep lookin'.
thanks, i'll be on the lookout for the blades.
hey, i found your weedwhacker blades!
hey, thanks for lookin' for those!
hold on, i gotta repay you somehow.
here, take these clippers. it's not much, but it's at least somethin'.
how's the clippers?
they're very clippy.
i used the clippers to find a flashlight, gary.
oh hey, i think i found a bag of...
uh, what is this?
oh, it's just weedwhacker blades. thought it was something else.
looks like there's a sign with directions.
it says the garden is south, the caves are east, the woods are west, and there's rosebushes north.
i've always wondered who decided to put four locations onto two arrow signs, though. maybe the points were made by accident?
that cave is looking very dark. i don't think i'd like to go inside.
